item.tib: rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas kyi dbang chog byin rlabs gru char
item.coloph: zhes drag po lha gsum gyi rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas kyi dbang chog 'di ni blo dman rnams la khyer bde klag chog du dril ba zhig dgos zhes mchog sprul rin po che'i bka' nan phab 'phral khro rigs yid ming pas 'don bder bgyis pa dge'o//
